mixed.tradeoff: Smaller/faster main model for routine work while keeping xhigh reasoning and maximum-depth review.

maximum.tradeoff: Highest available model profile with higher latency and token usage in exchange for maximum stability and depth.

policy.low_confidence_rule: Research more first. If confidence stays below 95%, escalate review to xhigh. Use the maximum profile for abstract, complex, or high-blast-radius work.
